# M2-C — deep expeditions through a complete resolution

Prepared continuation, **not dispatched**. Refresh this brief against the accepted B1/B2 source, contracts, ordinary-play saves, economy and review dispositions before dispatch. No production ownership or new worker is created by this document. Root supplies the actual committed parent, available port and GPU workflow status.

**Opus 5.5/high builds; a fresh non-author Sol 6.1/xhigh reviews.** One builder owns the connected game rules, geography, art, UI/audio, save migration and meaningful tests needed for this outcome. Choose implementation, internal checkpoints and tuning; propose useful design improvements. Root retains whole-game direction, integration and dispatch. This is an outcome boundary, not a file-by-file approval queue.

## Player outcome

Turn the established fleet into two satisfying ways of completing the adventure. An upgraded Creel uses sheltered approaches and restored service stops; Hearthline supports Mantle expeditions from suitable moorings. Both reach the **same complete canonical resolution**. These are two fleet strategies, not a request to invent two different story endings. Hush and Spindle remain useful optional choices. A player need not buy every hull or recover every personal log.

The deeper journey must repeatedly reward preparation with a new observation, useful capability or changed understanding. Ceramic, core and lattice come from recognizable source conditions, first reached with the preceding protection. New equipment changes the route or work the player can undertake; it does not merely authorize another identical shopping trip. Returning to an earlier refuge remains useful and comfortable.

Read the revised prompt, current STATUS/PLAN/CONTRACTS/MODEL_POLICY, accepted B1/B2 reports, `EXPEDITION_INTEGRATION`, `WORLD_PROGRESSION`, `FLEET_AND_SURVIVAL`, `STORY_DESIGN`, `GRAPHICS_PIPELINE` and `DELIVERY_AND_ACCEPTANCE`. The progression curve and M2 direction proposal explain earlier choices but their candidate recipes and old batch boundaries are not a second runtime registry. For story/world integration, read [the canon — major spoilers](../../spoilers/NARRATIVE_CANON.md) and [M2 narrative gates — major spoilers](../design/spoilers/M2-NARRATIVE-GATES.md). Keep their revelations out of ordinary updates, PR summaries and early player labels.

## Complete player-facing criteria

1. **Finish the connected world.** Build Ember Rift, Mirror Divide and Meridian District as actual traversable regions connected to the accepted early world. Preserve the seven stable region identities, three actual islands and approximately 2.0 × 1.8 km layout target down to the specified deep sites. An enlarged boundary, water plane or uniformly stretched old route is not world completion. Give each new habitat a major silhouette, recognizable environmental rule, investigation, source context and quiet preparation pocket. Provide the cooled Rift flank, broad Divide approach, narrow exterior service ledge and deep return escarpment with meaningful route choices. The exterior approaches must respect the canonical interior topology. Large hulls need visible turning spaces and moorings; small craft retain useful routes. Check actual rendered surfaces, physical collision, boarding, exits and source LOS together.
2. **Earn the protection ladder before needing it.** Ceramic at roughly 250–285 m and core at 280–320 m must be safely accessible on cooled/inactive Rift shoulders with the 350 m configuration. These fund the relevant 450 m personal/Creel capability. Lattice at 360–390 m on flushed Divide ledges is accessible before chemical protection and funds the 800 m service configuration, including personal exit protection. Place at least two matching first-access patches for each critical material. Blueprints, suitable fabrication, initial stock and return range all precede the protection they create. Pressure rating, thermal/brine tolerance and power are distinct; sealed breathing is not depleted merely because ambient water lacks oxygen. Hazard cues allow retreat without relying on color, a rare animal or an undiscovered coordinate marker.
3. **Complete the useful deep fleet.** Deliver Mantle as a paid, boardable, physically distinct 800 m service craft with visible fittings, protected work, precise station keeping and substantial power cost. Its benefits should be apparent beside an adapted Creel, which retains a workable sheltered route. Finish Creel 450/800 and its powered service head while preserving the earlier rack/cabin investments and meaningful utility-mount competition. Finish Hush's optional 450 m role and Hearthline's optional 550 m refit without granting Dart deep-district access or making Spindle submersible. Preserve actual personal/hull limit differences, supported refit locations, cargo/socket limits, intact module transfer and all earned carrier transactions.
4. **Make forward logistics pay off.** Restore useful Rift, Divide and exterior District service stops through paid local interactions, with storage, air/power and repair appropriate to each place. The nominal Rift280/Divide380/District650 m stops and carrier300/390/optional520 m moorings are tuning starting points, not permission to ignore the actual geometry. A Creel-first player can establish each stop using previous-tier stock, equipment and usable cargo capacity. Both strategies carry a sensible final repair load plus reserves; avoid repeated identical ferries. Facility service air/charging does not substitute for independently carried machinery support required by canon. Earlier infrastructure and hull investment remain useful after the final upgrades.
5. **A real, causal completion procedure.** Implement the complete protected narrative-gate specification: physical machinery interfaces, required support and repairs, visible state changes, safe access, meaningful final interaction and a resolution scene followed by continued exploration. No placeholder final button, detached text page or "coming later" endpoint. Resolve the central factual questions consistently with canon while allowing motives to remain debatable. Essential procedure comes from the actual facility and redundant evidence; optional personal playback is never a permission flag. Record discoveries out of order and adapt the notebook immediately. The necessary functional clues, alternate procedure source and ending belong to M2; M3 deepens the full authored treatment rather than supplying a missing ending.
6. **Deep loss remains recoverable.** Before enabling a newly hazardous route, demonstrate starter-accessible local rescue staging, the entire Bobbin tether route and either a clear tow destination or in-place salvage. Check the deepest newly placed sites, narrow gallery wrecks, blocked hatches, dry carrier assemblies, unpowered refuge and depleted reserve cells. Bobbin cannot carry the player, operate story machinery or replace the full expedition; visible camera discoveries still count. Recover critical modules, advanced frame materials and cargo locally when every advanced craft is disabled, without buying a duplicate upgraded vessel. A second failed rescue preserves earlier targets and a viable reusable rescue path. Unsafe mobile refuge selection falls back to the pod.
7. **Finite stock supports both routes and failure.** Reconcile actual recipes, frame returns, personal protection, service stops, support assemblies and finale repairs in the runtime registry. Prove required progress, a credible optional purchase and failed rescue at each tier with zero living-renewal credit. All first-access and reserve costs count; reject inaccessible-stock, random-drop or wait-for-regrowth budgets. Keep only the eight material families and the established living renewal rules. Food preparation, empty-inventory food access and small crops remain practical without thirst, spoilage or population-scale food grinding. Tune quantities and payloads from useful loads and return evidence rather than preserving an obsolete candidate ledger.
8. **Preserve legal state through interruptions and old saves.** Freeze the exact previous closed save domain before migrating. Preserve identities, stock/renewal, paid investments, modules, fleet/berths, refuge registration, cargo, losses, facts and journal protections; initialize new content once. Paused successful commands are immediately saveable and refusals are atomic. Paid repairs, placed support and machinery phases survive region eviction, incapacity and reload without duplicate consumption or reset. Reject illegal machinery/fleet combinations. Pause and interruption cannot leave an irreversible procedure in an unsafe half-state or run survival damage during a scene that prevents control. Retain the explicit-resume, writer-exclusion and import/replacement protections.
9. **Judge the connected experience and resource lifetime.** Use the richer cel direction in actual deep-water player views, with readable routes, hull work interfaces, hazard motion, refuge comfort and concise panels. Show relevant personal/hull readiness and one actionable refusal; avoid multiplying subtitles, tutorial paragraphs or simultaneous repeated notices. Seven-region traversal must exercise real eviction beyond the four-owner retained limit, return/state reconciliation, several hulls, same-page replacement, context loss, quality/resize and disposal. Declare first-entry/menu responsiveness budgets before evaluating them; retain the accepted warm50 ms criterion. Profile actual frame pacing and memory on the declared renderer/hardware, without relabelling callback rate or software rendering as dedicated-GPU game performance.

## Playable evidence and handoff

Demonstrate both strategies through the actual ending with ordinary production inputs. An unchanged, earned B1/B2 save may begin an affected deep continuation if its full provenance is retained; it is not a new start-to-ending run. The integrated M2 gate still requires fresh New Game-to-ending evidence for both strategies, including Creel-first without buying Dart or the carrier. Keep source-attributed saves, input/transfer/refit counts and representative motion so later integration can reuse valid evidence and reproduce real defects. Seeded economies, direct rule calls and teleports are labelled diagnostics, never earned play.

Record useful cargo and pre-refill oxygen/power for the first Rift, Divide and District round trips; the conservative intended approach targets at least 25% reserve. Measure repeated hauling and solved-route travel rather than using distance or recipe count as a human pacing claim. Exercise one paid Mantle outing where its work advantage matters, the adapted Creel alternative, carrier deployment and safe personal exits. Include actual reload/Continue and same-page import, blocked operations, interrupted machinery, missed optional evidence, early discoveries and all-advanced-hulls-disabled local recovery. Full canon-specific cases are in the protected gate document.

Run the composed check/build and meaningful economy/progression/migration checks. Review actual final imagery and motion, not only staged geometry. Browser work first reads `/work/repos/fleet/BROWSER_RULES.md` when available and `docs/BROWSER_RULES.md`; prefer the isolated T3 preview for ordinary work and the reviewed documented task-owned GPU workflow when available. Keep page input isolated, use only the assigned port and close only owned resources. Large evidence belongs on disk-backed `/work/tmp` or persistent home storage.

Return coherent committed source and `docs/build/evidence/M2-C-OPUS.md`, actual model/effort and checkout, final contracts/migration, finite economy and route evidence, remaining defects and useful design suggestions. Put spoiler-bearing analysis behind a labelled appendix. No children, push, PR, parent edits, merge or deployment unless root changes the assignment. Root inspects the composed source, freezes it and dispatches a fresh complete Sol6.1/xhigh review; corrections go to Opus and a new independent review round.

M2-C acceptance does not itself accept integrated M2. The latter combines all seven regions, six useful craft, three islands, both complete strategies, recovery and save resilience, then receives the technical gate and a fresh non-author Opus/high experience audit. M3 completes authored density, the full clue/voice/asset treatment and all hull missions; M4 adds the dedicated design critique, corrections and final release-candidate checks. Missing functional content is not a human-testing exception. Fresh-human enjoyment, route learning, mystery comprehension and approximately ten-hour duration remain unverified until observed; qualified delivery must state those limits honestly.
